about: Ground-truth superset / master data dump for Bhaskar Sengupta — a comprehensive, deduplicated accumulation of every detail across his three tailored CV variants (IT/OT Security Consultant, GRC/ISMS Associate, Senior Technical Analyst), his LinkedIn profile, and received recommendations. This is the source of truth from which role-tailored resumes are generated; it is not a one-page resume. Client engagements intentionally appear both as summarized Work highlights and as detailed Projects. Inline caveats and flagged values record wording variants across the CVs, LinkedIn-vs-CV reconciliations, and a few inferred fields (languages, preferences) that are NOT attested in any source document — confirm before use.

basics.name: Bhaskar Sengupta
basics.label: IT/OT Security & GRC Consultant · ISO 27001:2022 · NIST CSF 2.0 · IEC 62443 · ISO 27701 — 3.5+ Years

summaries.default: IT/OT and GRC cybersecurity consultant with 3.5+ years across PwC and EY, delivering IT/OT security assessments, ISMS design and audit, technology-risk engagements, and data-privacy compliance against ISO 27001:2022, NIST CSF 2.0, IEC 62443, and ISO 27701:2025 (PIMS). Track record of strengthening client security posture, closing compliance gaps, and enabling successful ISO certification across regulated industries.
summaries.itot-security-consultant: IT/OT Security Consultant with 3.5+ years of experience delivering IT and OT security assessments, technology risk engagements, IT/OT audits, and regulatory compliance projects. Supported organizations in strengthening security posture, managing risks, and achieving compliance across diverse industries.
summaries.grc-isms-audit: GRC and cybersecurity consultant with 3.5+ years across PwC and EY, specializing in ISMS design and audit against ISO 27001:2022, IT General Controls (ITGC), risk assessment, and regulatory compliance (NIST CSF, GDPR, DPDP Act) across global and Bangladesh-specific frameworks.
summaries.technical-analyst: Technical consultant with 3.5+ years across PwC and EY, experienced in diagnosing and triaging complex technical and compliance issues, translating stakeholder requirements into structured action plans, and producing clear documentation for technical and non-technical audiences.
summaries.data-privacy-consultant: Data privacy and protection consultant experienced in PIMS gap assessments, DPIA, ROPA, and data-flow mapping against ISO 27701:2025, GDPR, India's DPDP Act, and Bangladesh's PDPA & NDMA — delivering privacy roadmaps, records of processing activities, and management reporting that strengthen enterprise privacy compliance maturity.
summaries.linkedin-about-long-form: Cybersecurity Consultant at EY (ex-PwC) with expertise in IT/OT/IoT cybersecurity assessment, ISMS, risk analysis and risk management, penetration testing, maturity assessment, information security, policy formulation, data analysis, firewalls, Linux, vulnerability assessment, application security, and internal audit. Knowledge base spans ISO 27001, ISO 27002, NIST 800-53, NIST CSF 2.0, and ISO 27701 (PIMS), with in-depth knowledge of API security and a background in website development.
